name: PT Golden Flower Tbk
summary: PT Golden Flower Tbk operates as an apparel manufacturing company in the United States of America, Indonesia, Hong Kong, Mexico, Canada, Korea, Panama, the Netherlands, China, and internationally. It operates through Ladies Blouse; Man Shirt; and Uniform, Accessories, and Others segments. The company offers light to medium weight woven apparel, including ladies' blouses, men's shirts, non-iron shirts, casual shirts, skirts, dresses, nightwear, and uniforms, etc. It also provides garment services, such as research and development, designing, cutting, sewing, washing, ironing, and finishing, as well as smoking, faggoting, and pleating services.
